rationale: Review started 2026-11-25T01:20:29Z and ended 2026-11-25T01:25:02Z. All cited held texts were re-hashed (every source_fingerprints file and every evidence record's text_path matched its pinned sha256) and every record's text equals its file slice at char_start:char_end. Read the held original (31 FR 10601) in full: Executive Order 11294 of August 4, 1966, signed Lyndon B. Johnson, delegating per diem authority; four sections. Secs. 1, 3 and 4 amend EO 10621 (adding paragraph (o)), amend EO 11230 paragraph (9) and supersede EO 10970, all spent on issue (the OFR note's "EO 10960" is an editorial variant; the held text reads 10970). Sec. 2 is a continuing delegation to the Secretary of State. Basis ACT:EO:11294>EO:12561@3a10dc1de7e87947 and ACTOR_TEXT:EO:12561: the held FR text of EO 12561 of July 1, 1986 (51 FR 24299) reads in Sec. 3 "Executive Order No. 11294 of August 4,1966, is revoked." with no effective-date wording, so it ends the whole order on 1986-07-01; Sec. 2 re-delegates the successor authority to the Secretary of State and Sec. 1 revokes paragraph (o), which confirms a deliberate replacement. Earlier and partial ends: EO 11609 Sec. 11(5) supersedes only Section 3; EO 11609's last section makes the order effective immediately except paragraphs (1)-(13) and (19) of section 1, so Sec. 11 took effect 1971-07-22 (the machine ACT lead's 1971-10-20 date is correctly not adopted); EO 11609 Sec. 4 concerns 22 U.S.C. 2679, not Sec. 2. EO 12396 Sec. 5(a) revokes subsections (g)-(n) of EO 10621 Sec. 1, not (o). ACT:EO:11294>EO:11488 is a false lead (it cites EO 11230, not this order). The PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE flag is correctly resolved clause by clause. CURRENT:EO:11294#0 is an amending_order_in_status_line listing of EO 10621 and cannot show force. The held 3 U.S.C. 301 note reads "was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 12561, July 1, 1986" as quoted. Cruden hits (10) are only EO 11609, EO 12561, the order itself and the 3 U.S.C. 301 note; no revival. Status no, ended 1986-07-01, is supported by held sources.
